description: This file defines the interface for a JSON writer library in C. It provides functions to construct JSON objects and arrays programmatically, including appending various data types, nested objects, and arrays. It manages an internal buffer and open stack to format the JSON output and supports both pretty-printed and minified formats.

methods.name: jw_init
methods.description: Initializes the json_writer structure, setting up internal buffers and state for JSON construction.

methods.name: jw_release
methods.description: Releases internal resources and buffers used by the json_writer.

methods.name: jw_object_begin
methods.description: Starts a JSON object as the top-level structure, with optional pretty-printing.

methods.name: jw_array_begin
methods.description: Starts a JSON array as the top-level structure, with optional pretty-printing.

methods.name: jw_object_string
methods.description: Appends a string key-value pair to the current JSON object.

methods.name: jw_object_intmax
methods.description: Appends an integer value with a key to the current JSON object.

methods.name: jw_object_double
methods.description: Appends a double value with a key to the current JSON object, with specified precision.

methods.name: jw_object_true
methods.description: Appends a boolean true value with a key to the current JSON object.

methods.name: jw_object_false
methods.description: Appends a boolean false value with a key to the current JSON object.

methods.name: jw_object_bool
methods.description: Appends a boolean value with a key to the current JSON object.

methods.name: jw_object_null
methods.description: Appends a null value with a key to the current JSON object.

methods.name: jw_object_sub_jw
methods.description: Embeds another json_writer structure as the value for a key in the current object.

methods.name: jw_object_inline_begin_object
methods.description: Starts an inline nested JSON object as the value of a key.

methods.name: jw_object_inline_begin_array
methods.description: Starts an inline nested JSON array as the value of a key.

methods.name: jw_array_string
methods.description: Appends a string element to the current JSON array.

methods.name: jw_array_intmax
methods.description: Appends an integer element to the current JSON array.

methods.name: jw_array_double
methods.description: Appends a double element to the current JSON array with specified precision.

methods.name: jw_array_true
methods.description: Appends a boolean true value to the current JSON array.

methods.name: jw_array_false
methods.description: Appends a boolean false value to the current JSON array.

methods.name: jw_array_bool
methods.description: Appends a boolean value to the current JSON array.

methods.name: jw_array_null
methods.description: Appends a null value to the current JSON array.

methods.name: jw_array_sub_jw
methods.description: Embeds another json_writer as a value in the current JSON array.

methods.name: jw_array_argc_argv
methods.description: Appends a fixed number of strings from an argv array to the current JSON array.

methods.name: jw_array_argv
methods.description: Appends a null-terminated array of strings to the current JSON array.

methods.name: jw_array_inline_begin_object
methods.description: Starts an inline JSON object as a value within an array.

methods.name: jw_array_inline_begin_array
methods.description: Starts an inline JSON array as a value within an array.

methods.name: jw_is_terminated
methods.description: Checks if the entire JSON construction is complete and all objects and arrays are closed.

methods.name: jw_end
methods.description: Closes the current object or array, appending the appropriate closing character.
